title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning
subtitle: From supervised learning fundamentals to CNNs, RNNs, Transformers, and production MLOps deployment pipelines.

phases.title: Classical ML Algorithms & Model Evaluation
phases.description: Linear models, tree-based ensembles, unsupervised clustering, and rigorous model evaluation frameworks.

nodes.title: Linear Models, Regression & Classification
nodes.description: Linear regression, logistic regression, gradient descent, cost functions, and evaluation metrics.
topics: ML pipeline: problem definition, feature engineering, model training, evaluation
Linear Regression: cost function (MSE) and gradient descent optimization
Logistic Regression: sigmoid function, log-loss, and decision boundary
Model evaluation: Accuracy, Precision, Recall, F1, ROC-AUC curves
Overfitting vs underfitting: bias-variance tradeoff
Cross-validation: k-fold and stratified k-fold
checklist: Build and train a logistic regression classifier on a binary dataset.
Plot ROC-AUC curve and interpret the area under the curve.
Run 5-fold cross-validation and report mean ± std accuracy.

nodes.title: Tree-Based Algorithms & Ensemble Methods
nodes.description: Decision trees, Random Forest bagging, Gradient Boosting, XGBoost, and LightGBM ensembles.
topics: Decision Trees: entropy, information gain, Gini impurity, pruning
Random Forest: bagging, feature subspace sampling, OOB error
Gradient Boosting Machines (GBM): boosting principle, residual learning
XGBoost and LightGBM: regularization, learning rate, max depth
Hyperparameter tuning: GridSearchCV and RandomizedSearchCV
Feature importance and SHAP value interpretation
checklist: Train a Random Forest classifier and visualize feature importances.
Run XGBoost with early stopping on a Kaggle competition dataset.
Use GridSearchCV to optimize max_depth and n_estimators.

nodes.title: Unsupervised Learning, Clustering & Dimensionality Reduction
nodes.description: K-Means, hierarchical clustering, PCA, t-SNE, and UMAP for high-dimensional data exploration.
topics: K-Means clustering: centroid initialization, elbow method
Hierarchical clustering: dendrograms and linkage criteria
DBSCAN density-based clustering for non-spherical clusters
Principal Component Analysis (PCA): variance explained, scree plot
t-SNE and UMAP for high-dimensional visualization
Customer segmentation case study
checklist: Apply K-Means to a customer dataset and determine optimal k with elbow method.
Visualize high-dimensional embeddings using t-SNE.
Reduce a dataset from 50 to 5 dimensions using PCA.

phases.title: Deep Learning Foundations
phases.description: Neural network architecture, backpropagation, activation functions, and TensorFlow/Keras framework.

nodes.title: Neural Networks & Backpropagation
nodes.description: Perceptrons, multi-layer networks, activation functions, loss functions, and the backpropagation algorithm.
topics: Biological vs artificial neurons: perceptron model
Multi-layer Perceptrons (MLPs) and feedforward architecture
Activation functions: Sigmoid, Tanh, ReLU, Leaky ReLU, Softmax
Loss functions: Binary Cross-Entropy, Categorical Cross-Entropy, MSE
Backpropagation: chain rule and weight update mechanics
Build neural network from scratch in pure NumPy
checklist: Implement a 2-layer neural network from scratch in NumPy.
Verify gradients using numerical gradient checking.
Train the network on XOR problem and visualize decision boundary.

nodes.title: TensorFlow/Keras & CNNs for Computer Vision
nodes.description: Keras Sequential and Functional API, regularization, CNNs, pooling layers, and transfer learning with ResNet.
topics: TensorFlow 2 / Keras Sequential and Functional API
Optimizers: SGD, RMSprop, Adam; learning rate scheduling
Regularization: Dropout, L1/L2 weight decay, batch normalization
CNN architecture: Conv2D, MaxPool, GlobalAveragePooling
Popular CNN architectures: VGG, ResNet, MobileNet
Transfer learning: fine-tuning pre-trained ImageNet models

resources.title: Fast.ai Practical Deep Learning for Coders

checklist: Build a CNN image classifier on CIFAR-10 using Keras.
Apply transfer learning with ResNet50 on a custom 5-class dataset.
Use data augmentation to improve validation accuracy by 10%+.

phases.title: Sequence Models, Transformers & MLOps
phases.description: RNNs, LSTMs, attention mechanisms, Transformer architecture, model interpretability, and production deployment.

nodes.title: RNNs, LSTMs & Time Series Forecasting
nodes.description: Recurrent neural networks, LSTM/GRU gating mechanisms, and multi-step time series prediction.
topics: Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) architecture for sequential data
Vanishing gradient problem in RNNs
LSTM gate mechanism: Forget, Input, Output gates
GRU architecture vs LSTM trade-offs
Time series forecasting: windowing, multi-step prediction
Sentiment analysis with LSTM on text sequences
checklist: Train an LSTM on a stock price dataset for 5-day ahead forecasting.
Compare LSTM vs GRU performance on a text classification task.
Visualize LSTM hidden state activations.

nodes.title: Attention Mechanisms & Transformer Architecture
nodes.description: Self-attention, multi-head attention, Transformer encoder-decoder, and modern BERT/GPT architecture overview.
topics: Attention mechanism: Query, Key, Value and scaled dot-product
Self-attention and multi-head parallel attention
Transformer architecture: encoder stack, positional encoding
BERT (bidirectional encoder) and GPT (causal decoder) overview
Vision Transformer (ViT) for image classification
Text classification with Hugging Face Transformers
checklist: Implement scaled dot-product attention in NumPy/PyTorch.
Fine-tune a BERT model on a binary classification task.
Deploy a text classification API using Hugging Face + FastAPI.

nodes.title: MLOps, Model Interpretability & Production Deployment
nodes.description: Experiment tracking with MLflow, Docker containerization, cloud deployment, model drift detection, and SHAP explainability.
topics: Advanced cross-validation: stratified K-Fold, time-series CV
Hyperparameter tuning: Bayesian optimization with Optuna
Model interpretability: Feature importance, SHAP values, LIME
MLflow: experiment tracking, model versioning, and registry
Docker containerization of ML inference APIs
Cloud deployment: AWS SageMaker / Azure ML endpoints
checklist: Track 10+ experiments with MLflow and compare metrics dashboard.
Containerize a scikit-learn model API with Docker.
Generate SHAP summary plots explaining model predictions.
